summary: Sangoma Technologies filed a 6-K reporting a definitive arrangement agreement, announced September 28, 2026, under which a BRC Group Holdings (NASDAQ: RILY) subsidiary will acquire all issued Sangoma shares for US$4.925 cash plus 0.04767 BRC share each, implying US$5.225 (C$7.40) per share, a roughly 47% premium to the prior close and 51% to the 10-day VWAP. Enterprise value is about US$204 million (C$289 million); closing expected by early 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. Watch the shareholder vote and BRC stock drift, since consideration is part cash, part stock.
